newsitem.title: USA: Access sees Q4 and year earnings on target.
newsitem.headline: Access sees Q4 and year earnings on target.

text.p: Access Health Inc said Friday it expects fourth quarter and full-year earnings to be consistent with analysts' consensus estimates.
It also said it expects fiscal 1996 (ended September 30) revenues will be about double those reported for 1995.
First Call consensus estimates put fourth quarter earnings at $0.18 per share and year earnings at $0.60. A year earlier the company earned $0.14 a share for the quarter and $0.21 for the year.
Access Health said it will release fourth quarter and year-end results in November.
